content.short: ShapeShift DAO is a free, open-source platform to trade, track, buy, and earn crypto.
content.description: ShapeShift DAO is positioned as a gateway to a borderless financial system. It is an open-source, multi-chain, self-custody crypto platform that enables billions to achieve financial sovereignty. By supporting a wide range of networks and user-controlled assets, ShapeShift DAO aims to reduce reliance on centralized intermediaries and expand access to secure, portable value across borders. The project emphasizes transparency, user ownership, and broad accessibility as foundational elements of a more inclusive global financial ecosystem.
